purpose: Teach: 恐ろしく/耐える/説い/ただちに/従わ/免れ/我ら/ですけれど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店内が恐ろしく混雑してるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the store's packed today, isn't it?
lines.style: Light observation with an undercurrent of wry amusement. Conversational, almost conspiratorial. Sets the tone gently without complaint.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しさに耐える日々ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Days like this really test you, don't they?
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment of shared exhaustion. Not pitying — recognising. A small sigh beneath the words. Warm and understanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の魅力を説いて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer just now really sold the place, didn't they?
lines.style: Pleased surprise — she hadn't expected that. Light lift at the end. Genuine appreciation breaking through the tiredness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ただちにテーブルを片付けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should clear these tables right away, though.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Not urgent or panicked — just clear-eyed about what needs doing. A gentle directive, not a command.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、保健所の指示に従わないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We need to stay on top of the health codes.
lines.style: Steady, responsible tone. States the fact without drama. Someone who knows the rules exist for a reason and doesn't resent them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、清掃の手間を免れないけど頑張ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The cleaning isn't going anywhere, but we can handle it together.
lines.style: Honest but encouraging. Acknowledges the work without minimising it. A light squeeze of resolve — no performance, just steadiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、我ら店員はチームだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're a team in here, you and me.
lines.style: Tender and certain. Quiet emphasis on 'team' — the word carries weight. Looking at Aoi directly, not performing, just stating something true.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お忙しいですけれど少しゆっくりされてくださいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're busy, I know, but take a breath when you can, okay?
lines.style: Genuinely tender close. Lower register, slower pace. Not directive — an invitation. The care of someone who's watching to make sure you're okay.
